verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own marketing states it 'supports ASC 718 reporting', so the capability is documented first-party, but only as a single line with no detail on the reports themselves. Missing for 10: documentation of ASC 718 expense report contents and format (expense schedules, fair-value inputs, forfeitures), evidence that the reports are audit-ready or exportable for accountants, help-center guides for generating them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
